messages:
Diego: Heads up - SunField wants SLO language tailored to their compliance team. They asked for a clear formula for latency credits and a sample CSV export for monthly telemetry. Can we prioritize? @Mina @Sara
Mina: I can drive. Quick question: do they expect client-side latency or end-to-end? They specifically mentioned SDK-based timing so we should include both but prioritize end-to-end for credits.
Sara: We should include p95 and p99 in the appendix. Proposal: credits based on p95 > threshold more than X hours per month. Latency credit = (observed_p95 - target)/target * factor -> capped.
Joel: Finance: need two worked examples in USD and line items. Also clarifying: credits applied against next invoice, not refunded.
BillingBot: Billing rule: SLA credits will be applied as a negative line item on the next invoice issued after credit approval.
Diego: Good. Action items: @Mina write SLO appendix, include CSV schema, @Sara provide thresholds and telemetry query, @Joel prepare invoice examples. Target: Friday EOD.
Mina: Will add a short "exceptions" section covering 3rd-party network, DDoS mitigation actions, and customer-deployed hardware.
Sara: I'll include sample queries for our metrics system and a small CSV sample with p95/p99/uptime columns.
Diego: Schedule a 20m sync after drafts. Thanks.
